About me

Production-minded engineering. Practical teaching.

I work in Java backend development and enjoy breaking complex topics into clear, usable skills. My training approach combines fundamentals, code walkthroughs, design discussions, debugging, and project-based practice so learners understand not only how to build a feature, but why a solution works.

Who I help

Second offering · Training & mentorship

Build skills through guided, hands-on learning.

Training for both freshers and working professionals, with a focus on hands-on coding, practical scenarios, and interview confidence.

Track 01 · Language

Java 11, Java 17 & Java 21

Core Java, collections, streams, concurrency, CompletableFuture, version-by-version features, and when to use newer capabilities.

Track 02 · Backend

Spring Boot & REST APIs

Layered architecture, DTOs, validation, global exception handling, JPA, security basics, unit tests, and API best practices.

Track 03 · Architecture

Microservices

Service communication, resilience, retries, circuit breakers, distributed transactions, observability, and event-driven patterns.

Track 04 · Cloud

AWS for Java Developers

Deployable architecture concepts using EC2, S3, Lambda and RDS, configuration, permissions, and cloud-aware application design.

Track 05 · Relational data

SQL & PostgreSQL

From basic SELECT queries to joins, CTEs, window functions, indexes, transactions, and performance troubleshooting.

Track 06 · NoSQL data

NoSQL & MongoDB

CRUD, document schema design, indexes, aggregation pipelines, query patterns, and real-world data modeling choices.
